recognize_zh: 這是周邊血流式細胞儀 FLAER 分析：先以 FSC/SSC 與 CD15/CD33 區分顆粒球（綠）與單核球（藍），再看 CD24 或 CD14 對 FLAER；落在左下角 FLAER 陰性、CD24/CD14 陰性框內的族群即 GPI 缺失的 PNH clone。A–D 只有小族群（再生不良性貧血合併 2% clone），E–H 大部分細胞都在陰性框內（典型 PNH）。
features: Panels A/E: FSC vs SSC gating of leukocytes, granulocytes (green) and monocytes (blue)
Panels B/F: CD15 vs CD33 separating granulocytes (CD15 bright) from monocytes (CD33 bright)
Panel C: granulocytes mostly CD24+/FLAER+ with a small CD24-/FLAER- population in the lower-left gate (~2% clone)
Panel D: monocytes mostly CD14+/FLAER+ with few events in the negative gate
Panels G/H: most granulocytes are CD24-/FLAER- and most monocytes are CD14-/FLAER-, indicating a large PNH clone
describe_en: Multiparameter flow cytometry of peripheral blood leukocytes. Granulocytes (green) and monocytes (blue) are identified by light scatter and CD15/CD33 expression (A, B, E, F), then assessed for the GPI-anchored marker CD24 (granulocytes) or CD14 (monocytes) against FLAER, which binds the GPI anchor directly. In the aplastic anemia patient (C, D), the majority of granulocytes and monocytes retain CD24/CD14 and FLAER, with a small double-negative population in the lower-left gate representing a ~2% PNH clone. In the classic PNH patient (G, H), most granulocytes and monocytes fall within the CD24-/FLAER- and CD14-/FLAER- gates, indicating a large GPI-deficient clone. Findings are consistent with a small PNH clone in aplastic anemia (A-D) and classic PNH (E-H).
